predictions.text: Edmonton are the call tonight because everything measurable from the official record points one way. The Oilers return home at 8-1-1 with 47 goals scored and only 32 conceded across their opening ten games, the best attacking return on tonight's slate. Toronto bring a respectable 6-4-2 mark but have already shipped 39 in twelve, and the fractionally lighter workload still leaves them chasing the home side's numbers on a per-game basis. The Leafs have the firepower to make it interesting, yet over sixty minutes the steadier goal differential sits with the Oilers at Rogers Place. Our desk line prices Edmonton at exactly minus 250, the shortest number this grade is allowed to carry, and that is where the value read stops. Selection: Edmonton Oilers to win the match.
